## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `snowflake-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a warehouse and database

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your Snowflake account. -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to the Warehouses tab under the Admin section. -->
3. Select **+ Warehouse** and enter a name and type for the new warehouse.
4. <!-- manual: Select + Warehouse and enter a name and type for the new warehouse. -->
5. <!-- manual: Optionally, set the warehouse as the default for your account by editing the profile settings. :::note If you do not set a default warehouse, you must specify the warehouse name when creating a connection. ::: -->
6. Navigate to the **Databases** tab under the **Data** section and select **+ Database** to create a new database.
